overview.en:
Find contacts and profile details through Google’s official People API with your Google account.

Find people through the connected People service. Use names, organizations, or known contact details to disambiguate matches.

Select Connect in the plugin details. One Google account connection is shared by every installed Google plugin; granted permissions still limit each service.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 People API 与已连接的 Google 账号查找联系人与个人资料。

通过已连接的 People 服务查找联系人，用姓名、组织或已知联系方式区分同名结果。

在插件详情中选择“连接”。所有已安装的 Google 插件共用一次 Google 账号连接，各服务仍受已授予权限的限制。

starterPrompts.en: Find the contact information available for this person.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个人的可用联系信息。

starterPrompts.en: List contacts matching this name and explain ambiguous results.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 列出与这个名字匹配的联系人，并说明有歧义的结果。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a contact summary for the participants in this meeting.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这次会议的参会人准备联系人摘要。

descriptions.en: Use Google Contacts in Ghast. Find contacts and profile details through Google’s official People API with your Google account. 通过 Google 官方 People API 与已连接的 Google 账号查找联系人与个人资料。
